title: Unique generator-normalized scalar unit
statement: On a site satisfying the SystemScalarModel sheafification and smallness assumptions, let phi:R→R equal the identity and A be a SystemScalarModel for phi. There exists a unique isomorphism A.model.E≅Id sending the local tensor s tensor x to s times x on every section. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model].

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text:
Use the existing scalar unit comparison and its tensor equation. The local unit tensor
generators detect equality of any two candidate maps; evaluate the asserted formulas at scalar
one to prove uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarUnitUnique
    {R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} {φ : R ⟶ R} (hφ : φ = 𝟙 R)
    (A : SheafOfModules.SystemScalarModel φ) :
    ∃! a : A.model.E ≅ 𝟭 _, ∀ P U (s : R.obj.obj U) (x : P.val.obj U),
      (a.hom.app P).val.app U (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul A.model P U s x) =
        s • x
